search.query: 2025-08-15 AI/agent/model/security/policy/research 重新检索：优先官方公告、官方博客、论文和监管原文；核对 eventDate/publishedAt、canonical URL、sourceHash 与证据原话，重点复核 NVIDIA Granary/Canary/Parakeet、Anthropic Usage Policy、Claude 会话退出、Azure AKS CLI Agent，并排除 8/14 事件、8/16 以后预告及 GPT-5/Opus/Gemini 的后续或重复条目。

candidates.title: NVIDIA 开源 Granary 和 Canary/Parakeet，多语种语音 AI 扩展到 25 种欧洲语言

evidence.claim: NVIDIA 官方博客标注 August 15, 2025，宣布 Granary 数据集以及 Canary-1b-v2、Parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3。
evidence.excerpt: August 15, 2025 ... The new Granary dataset, featuring around 1 million hours of audio, was used to train high-accuracy and high-throughput AI models for audio transcription and translation.

evidence.claim: 首发范围是 25 种欧洲语言，Granary 约含一百万小时音频，两个模型已在 Hugging Face 提供。
evidence.excerpt: These tools ... support ... speech recognition and translation AI for 25 European languages ... Granary ... around a million hours of audio ... The dataset, as well as the new Canary and Parakeet models, are now available on Hugging Face.

evidence.claim: 模型与数据集的规模和速度数字是 NVIDIA 口径，正文需保留其评测边界。
evidence.excerpt: Canary-1b-v2 ... expands the Canary family’s supported languages from four to 25 ... up to 10x faster. ... Parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 ... capable of transcribing 24-minute audio segments in a single inference pass.

candidates.reason: 这是 8/15 最明确的开源数据集、模型和语音基础设施首发，覆盖低资源语言与可部署模型；文章需把约一百万小时、25 种语言和 leaderboard/速度数字写成 NVIDIA 公布的范围。

candidates.title: Anthropic 更新 Usage Policy，把 agentic 网络滥用和高风险消费场景写进边界

evidence.claim: Anthropic 官方页标注 Aug 15, 2025，并说明新政策将于 9 月 15 日生效。
evidence.excerpt: Aug 15, 2025 ... Today, we’re sharing some updates to our Usage Policy ... These changes will take effect on September 15, 2025.

evidence.claim: 新政策针对恶意计算机、网络和基础设施入侵活动，同时保留经系统所有者同意的安全研究。
evidence.excerpt: We’ve added a section to our Usage Policy outlining the malicious computer, network, and infrastructure compromise activities that are prohibited by Anthropic. We continue to support use cases that strengthen cybersecurity, such as discovering vulnerabilities with the system owner’s consent.

evidence.claim: 高风险面向消费者的法律、金融和就业场景需要额外保障，如人工在环和 AI 披露。
evidence.excerpt: These cases require additional safeguards such as human-in-the-loop oversight and AI disclosure.

candidates.reason: 这是当天影响 agent 使用边界和企业风险评估的正式政策更新；文章必须区分 8/15 发布、9/15 生效，以及政策文字对既有允许/禁止范围的澄清。

candidates.title: Claude Opus 4/4.1 可在极端有害对话中结束会话

evidence.claim: Anthropic 8 月 15 日宣布，Claude Opus 4 和 4.1 在消费端对话界面获得结束极少数会话的能力。
evidence.excerpt: Aug 15, 2025 ... We recently gave Claude Opus 4 and 4.1 the ability to end conversations in our consumer chat interfaces.

evidence.claim: 触发范围被限定为持续有害/辱骂且多次重定向无效的极端情形，并且不会用于用户可能即将自伤或伤人的情况。
evidence.excerpt: This ability is intended for use in rare, extreme cases of persistently harmful or abusive user interactions. ... Claude is directed not to use this ability in cases where users might be at imminent risk of harming themselves or others.

evidence.claim: 结束会话后用户可新开对话、反馈或编辑重试此前消息；Anthropic 称该功能仍是持续实验。
evidence.excerpt: When Claude ends a conversation, the user will no longer be able to send new messages in that conversation ... they will be able to start a new chat immediately. We’re treating this feature as an ongoing experiment.

candidates.reason: 这是同日少见的模型行为与对齐机制公开更新；正文要把它写成极端边界下的实验性退出机制，不能扩写为模型拥有自主权或普遍拒答逻辑。

candidates.title: 微软发布 AKS CLI Agent：用人类在环方式做集群诊断

evidence.claim: 微软 AKS 工程博客标注 August 15, 2025，宣布 CLI Agent for AKS，并说明当前只向一组有限用户提供 early access。
evidence.excerpt: August 15, 2025 ... CLI Agent for AKS is a new AI-powered command-line experience ... We are currently providing early access to a limited set of users.

evidence.claim: CLI Agent 组合 HolmesGPT 和 AKS-MCP，面向网络/DNS、Pod 调度、节点健康和集群 CRUD 故障诊断。
evidence.excerpt: Built on open-source building blocks — including the CNCF-pending HolmesGPT agent and the AKS Model Context Protocol (MCP) server ... We focused on 4 main types of problems for troubleshooting: networking/DNS, pod scheduling, node health, and cluster CRUD issues and failures.

evidence.claim: 微软刻意从人类在环 CLI 起步，工具执行和变更需要用户明确许可。
evidence.excerpt: The AKS Agentic CLI is designed to assist, not replace, the Kubernetes cluster operator ... No changes are made to the cluster without explicit user permissions.

candidates.reason: 它把 agent、MCP 工具和基础设施运维放到一个可审计的 CLI 里，且官方明确是 limited preview 和人类在环；文章需保留访问范围与权限边界。

candidates.title: Google Gemini Drop 汇总个性化和 Temporary Chat（与 8/13 首发重复）

evidence.claim: Gemini Drop 页面标注 Aug 15, 2025，但把 Temporary Chat 和过去对话个性化作为当月更新清单的一部分。
evidence.excerpt: Aug 15, 2025 ... You can now use Temporary Chats to have conversations that won’t be saved to your history or influence future responses. ... Gemini can use your past chats to give you more personalized and relevant answers.

evidence.claim: 同一功能已在 8/13 Google 官方博客首发并进入当日选中事件。
evidence.excerpt: Aug 13, 2025 | Gemini adds Temporary Chats and new personalization features.

candidates.reason: 8/15 是月度汇总页，核心功能和首发边界已由 8/13 官方博客记录；不把汇总页重复写成新事件。

evidence.claim: Claude 发布说明在 August 15 段落只记录计划计费变更，Opus 4.1 的条目仍标注 August 5, 2025。
evidence.excerpt: August 15, 2025 ... Ability to change monthly Team plan billing to annual ... August 5, 2025 ... Claude Opus 4.1 ... brings enhanced performance as our most capable model.

evidence.claim: Anthropic 的 Opus 4.1 正式公告日期是 Aug 5, 2025。
evidence.excerpt: Aug 5, 2025 ... Introducing Claude Opus 4.1.

candidates.reason: 发布说明页在 8/15 的更新不能改变 Opus 4.1 的 8/5 首发日期；与 8/5 已记录文章合并。

evidence.excerpt: Updated on August 15, 2025 ... San Francisco—August 18, 2025—Grammarly ... today announced it will launch eight specialized AI agents.

evidence.claim: 该事件属于 8/18 发布，不能按页面编辑日期倒填至 8/15。

candidates.reason: 日期边界排除：页面编辑日期为 8/15，但公司公告明确是 8/18；留到 8/18 研究。
